notes.title: Patch Notes - 1.1.0
notes.notes:
Hello members of the hive,

We are pleased to tell you that the development team has been working on a small update to fix some issues addressed by the community.

General Fixes


 Achievements are now available for Bee Simulator
 Gamepad support added for Xbox Controller, Switch Controller Pro, Dualshock 4, Dualsense, Directinput Controller, Steam Controller


See you inside the beehive!
